extracted.name: Dirty Rice
extracted.description: This easy Dirty Rice recipe is a popular Cajun dish made with white rice that becomes "dirty" in color when cooked with beef, sausage, chicken, veggies and spices. It's made in just one pot and is a hearty, flavorful meal everyone will love!
ingredient_lines: ½ lb ground sausage ((227g), (I use Jimmy Dean pork sausage))
½ cup minced chicken livers or gizzards* ((120g))
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper ((1g))
2 cups long-grain white rice ((370g), or basmati rice)
instruction_lines: Cook meat: Add ground beef, sausage and liver to a large saucepan over medium heat. Season with salt and pepper and cook, crumbling with a wooden spoon, until browned.
Add flour and stir. Add onion, bell pepper, and celery and sauté for 2 minutes. Add garlic, Cajun seasoning, cayenne, oregano, thyme and bay leaves and stir to combine.

Simmer: Add rice and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat all allow to rest for 5 minutes. Remove lid, gently fluff rice with a fork, reapply lid and rest for 5 more minutes.
Serve garnished with green onion and parsley.
